info.title: FirstSales Developer API
info.description: Public v1 developer API for FirstSales.io. Generated from live step definitions — do not hand-edit.

tags.name: Signals
tags.description: Beta. Find people who comment on or react to LinkedIn posts by a keyword, a person or a company page. Each scan costs 10x the scraper cost in credits (1 credit = $0.01), capped by the daily budget of the signal. A scan that adds no new person is free.

bearerAuth.description: Legacy compatibility bearer scheme for generated consumers.

developerKeyBearer.description: FirstSales developer API key bearer token (fs-key-*).

oauthBearer.description: Reserved OAuth bearer scheme for future public OAuth operations.

publicPath.description: Relative public metadata address from the exact saved tenant, owner publication and event, or null when unavailable. An address does not establish booking, intake or provider eligibility.

rawKey.description: Reveal-once API key secret. Store it securely; it cannot be retrieved later.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated booking statuses: approval_pending, provider_pending, confirmed, declined, expired, cancel_pending, cancelled, failed, no_show, attended.

get.description: Organization-owned Calendar catalog. Requires a current organization administrator, org:view and calendar:view. Organization API keys require organizations:read and calendar:read; workspace keys and wildcard-only keys are insufficient. wsId is a live workspace authorization/audit anchor in the exact organization. This read cannot publish or change aliases.
